frozen_build.method: Independently enumerate declared source roots/extensions, stream-hash every file and every source tar member, reproduce canonical sorted-JSON aggregate, compare both build snapshots and private binary to independently supplied frozen identities.

historical_architecture_archive.method: Strictly parse every recorded SHA256SUMS entry, reject duplicates/unsafe paths, require the complete on-disk file inventory to match all 293 entries, and independently rehash all bytes. The existing historical manifest is the reference.

preserved_engine_and_extended.method: Stream SHA-256 of each current file, equality to retained 40-file manifest, and independent SHA-256 of each Git baseline blob.

scope: Independent read-only rehash of the requested preserved runtime/Extended files, final source build inputs and private binary, source archive, and historical architecture archive. No benchmark performance or whole-engine proof claim.
